subject: Depth & confidence sweep — Q2 commit and stage updates for PineCo
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@pineco.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Huang <lydia@pineco.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync — Q2 coverage and dates

Hey Markus,

Hope you're well. With our internal budget freeze lifting next month, Finance asked me to confirm whether the timeline you shared for deployment and onboarding still maps to a late-June commit. We need a tight picture of remaining risk so we can make an internal approval recommendation.

Can you send a short note on:
- current confidence level for a June close (high/medium/low)
- any specific stage hygiene actions you need from our side this week
- dependencies that might push to July

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Lydia and I are trying to lock the Q2 book this week.

Thanks,
Samir
Account Exec, PineCo

---
P.S. If it helps, a simple snapshot of remaining open items by owner is perfect.

From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@pineco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Q2 coverage and dates

Samir — thanks for the note. Looping Marissa and Aditya for the play-by-play and to confirm the internal runbook we're executing this week.

Quick summary from my side:
- Confidence: medium-high for a June 28th commit. Main hinge is a short procurement hold at PineCo (sounds like that clears next week).
- Major risks: open SOC-2 evidence (we provided most artifacts; waiting on receipt acknowledgement), and a final SOW redline on the Term Sheet (legal review).
- Stage hygiene ask: please ensure the procurement owner at PineCo confirms billing address and PO flow by EOD Wednesday. That removes one gating item.

Marissa — can you attach the updated pipeline snapshot and call out any opportunities we should de-risk (top-3)? Aditya — can you confirm the commit math and whether our coverage hits the target if two of the three mid-stage deals convert by month-end?

Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@pineco.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Q2 coverage and dates

Thanks Markus. Attaching the pipeline_snapshot_Q2.xlsx and a short MAP (attached: MAP_v3.pdf) — highlights below.

Snapshot highlights (top of file):
- Current pipe-to-quota: 2.8x overall, but weighted confidence (based on stage and champion strength) puts effective coverage at 1.2x for targeted June revenue.
- Three deals we recommend re-prioritizing for active stewardship this week: PineCo (DEAL-78321), ArloMed (stg: Negotiation), and ClearWave (stg: Legal).

Recommended actions (this week):
1) PineCo: move from "Commit - verbal" to "Commit - PO pending" once procurement confirms billing/PO flow. Owner: Samir (PineCo) + Markus (Redwood). Target: 2029-06-21.
2) ArloMed: accelerate exec demo and finalize discount terms. Owner: Marissa. Target: 2029-06-24.
3) ClearWave: request final legal redline meeting. Owner: Aditya. Target: 2029-06-26.

Commit math (Aditya, feel free to correct): if PineCo (60% weighted), ArloMed (50%), and ClearWave (40%) close as per the above targets, we reach ~98% of quota — that leaves a small runway gap but within acceptable remediations (short-term promotional top-up or a small upsell).

Samir — action items for PineCo: confirm PO flow and provide billing contact. Once you confirm, we'll update the stage and you should see the change reflected in the attached snapshot.

Thanks — attaching files now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pipeline_snapshot_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1.1MB)
Attachment: MAP_v3.pdf (sales MAP, 420KB)

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 16:42:00 -07:00

Quick number check — pulled the workbook and ran two scenarios: conservative and optimistic. TL;DR below.

- Conservative: PineCo slips to July (0% in Q2), ArloMed converts at 50%, ClearWave at 40% -> coverage falls to ~0.86x (gap ~14%).
- Optimistic: PineCo commits in June (as Marissa outlined), ArloMed & ClearWave close at targets -> coverage ~1.03x (surplus ~3%).

Remediation levers if conservative scenario looks likely:
- Short promotional bridge (2-week trial + limited credit) to accelerate PineCo sign-off (requires approval; I can draft proposed language).
- Re-prioritize two mid-market pilots we already have in the funnel and escalate to exec sponsors this week.

Actionable asks by EOD Thursday:
- Samir: confirm PO/billing flow (critical).
- Marissa: flag any commitments in the spreadsheet that are purely timeboxed demos vs. exec-sponsored opportunities.
- Markus: if we need an exec-ops call with PineCo this week, say the word and I’ll set it up.

I’ll maintain the workbook; sending a one-line update when PineCo status changes.

-Aditya
Account Strategy, Redwood Inference
